name: Cattolica (Italy)
description: Horizontal stripes of blue, red, orange and yellow, the blue charged at the hoist with a white stylised wave device and the name Cattolica.
history: Municipal flag of Cattolica, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: stylised wave device with the name Cattolica
